facts.fact: TechCabal reports PesaLink, operated by IPSL and owned by the Kenya Bankers Association, sends money instantly between accounts at different banks, and that Airtel Money has now joined it.

IPSL chief Gituku Kirika said on 18 November 2026 that PesaLink is available across all banks and has gone live with person-to-merchant till, paybill and QR payments, so far with Equity Bank and SBM at Quickmart; he says half its payments start or end at a business.
